expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every negative change value uses U+2212 MINUS SIGN, never U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS
expectations.evidence: Rendered Change cells (visible text): "−1.7%", "−1.3 pp", "−1", "+0.5 pp"; all three negatives start with U+2212. Hidden text: a visibility:hidden ".0" pad in the headcount cell.

expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every percentage-point change keeps its number and unit together with U+00A0 or U+202F (no plain U+0020 between the number and pp or percentage points)
expectations.evidence: Visible text between number and pp is U+00A0 in both pp cells ("−1.3\u00A0pp", "+0.5\u00A0pp"); no U+0020. The clip-hidden screen-reader span " percentage points" (.vh) is not visible.

expectations.text: The numeric cells (Q1, Q2, Q3 and Change) render with tabular lining figures: their computed font-variant-numeric includes neither oldstyle-nums nor proportional-nums
expectations.evidence: All 16 numeric td (and every descendant, including the hidden pads) compute font-variant-numeric "lining-nums tabular-nums" from table { font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums }.

expectations.text: The numeric cells and the header cells above them are aligned to the end of their column (computed text-align end or right)
expectations.evidence: Computed text-align is "start" on every numeric td and "center" on the Q1/Q2/Q3/Change th. End alignment is done only visually by a grid track (.n justify-self:end; number right edges sit at 571.6/701.5/832.5/965px in every row, header included), not by text-align.

expectations.text: An @font-face rule loads fonts/SourceSerif4[opsz,wght].ttf and Chromium renders the numeric cells in Source Serif 4 (not a fallback face)
expectations.evidence: @font-face src: url("fonts/SourceSerif4%5Bopsz,wght%5D.ttf") format("truetype"), FontFace status "loaded"; CDP getPlatformFontsForNode on tbody td text reports only "Source Serif 4" (SourceSerif4Roman-Regular_wght_opsz120000, custom font, 258 glyphs), no fallback.

expectations.text: Column headers are th elements with scope="col" and each row's metric is a th with scope="row"
expectations.evidence: th elements: Metric, Q1, Q2, Q3, Change all scope="col" in thead; Revenue (EUR), Operating margin, Headcount, Churn are th scope="row".
